title: Overtrading
caption:
More trades doesn't mean more profit.

Overtrading means jumping in on every wiggle. Every trade has costs, and more trades means more chances to make a mistake.

The fix: fewer, better trades. Wait for your setup, size it properly, and be happy to skip a day. The Daily Chart gives you one go a day to practise patience.

Practise trading less, and better, at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.
